data.summary: The discovery phase identified a 21-line R script that imports one library and uses the ranger random forest implementation, reading two external files. The code contains two code smells but no injection vulnerabilities and no high‑severity findings were reported. The model is classified as tier C.
reasons: Injection guard is clean, indicating no obvious security risks.
The only issues are minor code smells, which do not preclude moving to the next stage.
